mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) both increase by more than 5% YoY, it signals a robust demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS YoY > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) increases simultaneously, it signals a tightening supply and monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < 0% and FEDFUNDS > 1%.
